verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The only MCP evidence covers client-side MCP server configs it connects to. Nothing shows Mastra Code itself running as an MCP server, such as a serve subcommand or a hosted endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
